title: Full Stack Portfolio Website
description: A full-stack portfolio website built using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It showcases my projects, technical skills, resume, and includes a functional contact form with backend integration.

title: Wanderlust
description: A full-stack Airbnb-inspired web application built using MongoDB, Express.js, Node.js, and EJS. Features include user authentication, property listings, image uploads, wishlist, booking system, Razorpay payments, reviews, user profiles, search, and category-based filtering.

title: URL Shortener
description: A MERN stack web application that converts long URLs into short, shareable links with QR code generation and instant redirection.
